widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> a korean high ponytail, female of Ironman triathlete in his early 20s, athletic build, light stubble, wearing a blue and white tri-suit. Reference to <Picture 1> for facial identity, the face remains consistent and clearly visible in front view and slightly side view across all shots.
(<Subject 2> is triathlon bike for <Subject 1>:0.95)

summary:
A continuous Ironman Triathlon story following the same female triathlete <Subject 1> from start to finish. All clips are one-shot with no cuts, medium close-up framing, eye-level tracking camera in front of the subject, face always visible and in sharp focus, showing no degradation of facial identity over long duration.

retention_analysis:
Live-action, cinematic, ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO CUTS, NO EDITS
<Subject 1>'s triathlon is <Subject 2>, other bike is different style and color.
